stories.title: Token Schema and Persistence Model
stories.description: Design and implement the MongoDB schema for bearer tokens including fields for token hash, issued_at, expires_at, status (active/revoked), rotation_parent_id, and audit metadata. Ensure secure storage (hashed tokens only) and indexing for lookup and expiration queries.

stories.title: Token Rotation Logic and Policy Enforcement
stories.description: Implement core rotation logic including generation of new tokens, invalidation or chaining of prior tokens, and enforcement of rotation policies (e.g., max lifetime, single active token per client if required). Ensure atomic updates to prevent race conditions.

stories.title: Token Expiration and TTL Enforcement
stories.description: Implement expiration handling using TTL indexes and runtime validation checks. Ensure expired tokens are automatically invalidated and cannot be used for authentication, with clear error responses and audit logging.

stories.title: Token Management API Contract
stories.description: Define and implement internal API contracts for token issuance, rotation, and status checks. Ensure consistent request/response schemas, error handling, and alignment with existing GPTReader authentication flows.
